answer: Time-locked vesting blunts sybils: each identity's earnings vest over 26 epochs, and any account caught colluding forfeits its unvested balance. A farmer who spins up a nebula of 500 fake agents must keep every one doing fresh verified work for the whole voyage, paying compute daily while nothing is withdrawable, and a single detected link, like a vine joining their roots, lets the network slash all of them at once. Cheap identities become expensive, illiquid liabilities.
